title: Platform engineering standup — sprint 61 sync (control plane / routing / auth / quotas)
body:
Attendees: Evelyn (owner), Marco, Priya, Samir, Olga, Liam (notes).

Duration: 35m. Goal: quick sync on the high-risk items for the week, unblock rollouts, and capture action items. This is a working notes doc (informal).

Highlights / quick status
- Control plane: canary rollout of v2 auth-middleware started yesterday to 5% of traffic. No user-facing errors in the last 12h, but saw increased 503 spike on region-eu-west-1 during peak. Root cause candidate: connection pool exhaustion on auth-service. (See incident notes below).
- Routing: traffic-shaping prototype (load-aware fallback) landed in feature branch; performance tests show ~8% latency improvement for 99th pct when KV-cache hit > 60%. Needs integration testing with Dedicated pools.
- Auth: token introspection optimization merged in branch; memory usage down ~20% on bench. One regression found with long-lived websocket sessions — session refresh path not hitting cache.
- Quotas: quota-enforcement telemetry pipeline prototype is functional; sampling shows ~2.3% of pre-production traffic would have been throttled under current default quotas. Need to surface per-customer impact to sales.

Incidents / Alerts
- 2026-03-10 17:40UTC: 503 spike in eu-west-1 (~3.4% of requests) coincident with a burst of deployments to the same cluster. Symptoms: auth-service 502->upstream-reset, prolonged TCP CLOSE_WAIT. Hypothesis: connection pool limits + short-lived client sockets from rollout agent.
  - Immediate mitigation: scaled auth-service from 6->12 pods in region, reduced canary weight to 1%. Errors dropped to baseline within 9 minutes.
  - Next steps (owner: Marco, due 2026-03-15): increase default socket timeout for rollout agent, add connection pool metrics to dashboards, and add a soft-limit circuit breaker on rollout agent concurrency. Ticket: PLAT-2819.

Detailed notes by area
1) Control plane
  - Canary plan: v2 auth-middleware is in canary (1% -> 5% ramp). Observability: added tracing span for auth-latency and a histogram by route.
  - Open risk: control-plane API server CPU contention during bursts (observed in dev cluster). Action (Priya): schedule an isolated soak test with 10k rps for 2h, compare top-down CPU + hedge autoscaler behavior. Due 2026-03-13.
  - Decision: keep rollout paused at 5% until we confirm connection pool fix in auth-service.

2) Routing
  - Work completed: feature branch (load-aware fallback) merged to integration; bench results attached in linked PR.
  - TODO: integration test with dedicated-gpu-sim (owner: Samir, due 2026-03-16). Need to validate latency tail and cache-coherence when falling back between model variants.
  - Parking-lot: add canary routing by customer tier (enterprise vs free) — deprioritized for this sprint.

3) Auth
  - Progress: token introspection caching landed; memory improved but websocket path uses legacy refresh loop.
  - Blocker: legacy websocket client lib not honoring new cache headers (owner: Olga). Olga to open PR for shim and add unit tests. Due 2026-03-14.
  - Monitoring: add websocket refresh failure counter and alert at >0.5% of connections per hour. (Owner: Evelyn).

4) Quotas and Billing Signals
  - Prototype pipeline (Kinesis -> transform -> metrics) shows accurate enforcement events. Sampling indicates quota thresholds are conservative for PLG users.
  - Action (owner: Liam): run a cost-impact analysis for lowering default quotas by 10% for new signups and produce a one-pager for GTM by 2026-03-18.

Action items (short list)
- Marco: connection pool fixes + add pool metrics to dashboards. Ticket PLAT-2819. Due 2026-03-15.
- Priya: soak test for control-plane CPU contention; report with graphs. Due 2026-03-13.
- Olga: websocket cache-shim PR + tests. Due 2026-03-14.
- Samir: integration test of routing fallback with dedicated simulator. Due 2026-03-16.
- Evelyn: add websocket refresh failure alert and OWNERS for the alert. Due 2026-03-13.
- Liam: quota cost one-pager for GTM. Due 2026-03-18.

Decisions made
- Pause ramp beyond 5% for auth-middleware until pool fixes validated.
- Defer routing-by-customer-tier to next sprint.

Parking lot / future discussion items
- Revisit quota default for PLG signups after cost analysis.
- Consider per-region pool sizing heuristics based on historical burst patterns (spike detection + pre-scale).
- Long-term: investigate a shared connection-proxy for auth to reduce per-pod socket count.

Misc notes / cross-team asks
- SRE: please add control-plane API server CPU+heap dashboards to the platform overview page (request from Priya). Ticket to SRE: create and assign.
- Sales/CS: Liam to sync with sales on quota impacts before any user-facing change.

Next sync
- Weekly standup: 2026-03-18 09:30PT. If any of the action items hit blockers, create a short follow-up meeting and ping #platform-ops.

Notes to self (Evelyn): update runbook with canary rollback steps and the temporary mitigation steps used yesterday (scale auth-service, reduce canary weight). Also paste graphs from Datadog into this doc after Priya's soak results arrive.

End of notes.
